name: ie_law_search
description: Search Irish Acts of the Oireachtas by words in the title, e.g. "data protection" or "companies". Reads the Statute Book year by year, so it covers a range of years: by default the last 25 years; set from_year (as early as 1922) and to_year to widen or narrow, e.g. from_year 1988 to_year 1988 for the Data Protection Act 1988. Returns Act number, year, title and a link; matches are newest first. Acts only (not statutory instruments). Pair with ie_law_get for contents and section text.

query.description: Word(s) from the Act title, e.g. "data protection"

from_year.description: First year to search (default: 24 years before to_year; earliest 1922)

to_year.description: Last year to search (default: the current year)

name: ie_law_get
description: Fetch one Irish Act by year and number (e.g. year 2018, number 7 for the Data Protection Act 2018). Returns title, citation, long title, date, the list of sections and schedules, and whether a consolidated Revised Act exists and how current it is. Pass section (e.g. "10", "10A" or "schedule 2") for that provision's text. Text is as enacted by the Oireachtas; later amendments are not applied, so in_force is true only where a Revised Act exists (the Act is then in force at least in part) and otherwise unknown (null).

number.description: Act number in that year, e.g. 7
